name: ac-infrastructure-and-project-finance
description: Analysing infrastructure and project finance on the cash flow rather than the asset: concession life and handback, availability versus demand risk, debt service coverage and lock-up tests, capital expenditure through the asset's life, refinancing and the equity return, inflation linkage in the tariff, and the written project record. It explains the contractual and cash-flow structure; it never recommends an asset and never predicts a project's outcome. Use when asking "project finance", "concession", "availability payment", "DSCR", "infrastructure debt", "handback", "demand risk", "toll road", "aircraft leasing", "rolling stock", "PPP", "refinancing gain share". Not for infrastructure funds and vehicles (ac-alternatives-and-real-assets), not for direct property rental economics (ac-direct-real-estate), not for municipal revenue bonds (ac-municipal-bonds).
